camel_example: aliyun sts AssumeRoleWithOIDC --region cn-hangzhou --Policy '{"Statement":[{"Action":["*"],"Effect":"Allow","Resource":["*"]}],"Version":"1"}' --OIDCToken eyJraWQiOiJKQzl3eHpyaHFKMGd00000 --RoleSessionName TestOidcAssumedRoleSession --OIDCProviderArn 'acs:ram::1135115445850000:oidc-provider/TestOidcIdp' --DurationSeconds 3600 --RoleArn 'acs:ram::1135115445850000:role/testoidc'
description_en: For role-based single sign-on (SSO) that uses OpenID Connect (OIDC), call the AssumeRoleWithOIDC operation to obtain a temporary identity credential (a Security Token Service token) to assume a RAM role
description_zh: 进行OIDC角色SSO时，通过调用AssumeRoleWithOIDC接口，获取扮演RAM角色的临时身份凭证（STS Token）
kebab_example: aliyun sts assume-role-with-oidc --biz-oidc-provider-arn acs:ram::1135115445850000:oidc-provider/TestOidcIdp --role-arn acs:ram::1135115445850000:role/testoidc --oidc-token eyJraWQiOiJKQzl3eHpyaHFKMGd00000 --policy '{"Statement":[{"Action":["*"],"Effect":"Allow","Resource":["*"]}],"Version":"1"}' --duration-seconds 3600 --biz-role-session-name TestOidcAssumedRoleSession --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssumeRoleWithOIDC

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the OIDC identity provider.

You can view the ARN of the OIDC identity provider in the RAM console or by calling an API operation:

RAM console: For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327123.html.
API: For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327126.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327127.html
parameters.help_zh:
OIDC身份提供商的ARN。

您可以通过RAM控制台或API查看OIDC身份提供商的ARN。具体如下：

RAM控制台：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327123.html。
API：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327126.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327127.html
parameters.name: oidc_provider_arn

parameters.help_en:
The ARN of the RAM role that you want to assume.

You can view the ARN of the role in the RAM console or by calling an API operation:

RAM console: For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39744.html.
API: For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28713.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28711.html
parameters.help_zh:
需要扮演的RAM角色ARN。

您可以通过RAM控制台或API查看角色ARN。具体如下：

RAM控制台：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39744.html。
API：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28713.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28711.html
parameters.name: role_arn

parameters.help_en:
The OIDC token that is issued by an external IdP.

The token must be 4 to 20,000 characters long.

Enter the original OIDC token. Do not Base64-decode the token
parameters.help_zh:
由外部IdP签发的OIDC令牌（OIDC Token）。

长度：4~20000个字符。

需要输入原始OIDC Token，无需Base64解码
parameters.name: oidc_token

parameters.help_en:
An access policy to further restrict the permissions of the STS token.

If you specify this policy, the permissions of the STS token are the intersection of the permissions that are granted to the RAM role and the permissions that are specified in this policy.
If you do not specify this policy, the STS token has the same permissions as the RAM role.

The policy must be 1 to 2,048 characters long
parameters.help_zh:
为STS Token额外添加的一个权限策略，进一步限制STS Token的权限。具体如下：

如果指定该权限策略，则STS Token最终的权限取RAM角色权限策略与该权限策略的交集。
如果不指定该权限策略，则STS Token最终的权限就是RAM角色的权限。

长度：1~2048个字符
parameters.name: policy

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the token, in seconds.

Valid values: 900 to the value of the `MaxSessionDuration` parameter. The default value is 3600.

For more information about how to set the `MaxSessionDuration` parameter, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28710.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28712.html
parameters.help_zh:
Token有效期。单位：秒。

默认值：3600。最小值：900。最大值：`MaxSessionDuration`设置的时间。

关于设置角色最大会话时间`MaxSessionDuration`的具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28710.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28712.html
parameters.name: duration_seconds

parameters.help_en:
The name of the role session.

A custom parameter used to distinguish role sessions. The value is typically the identity of the user who calls the operation, such as a username. In ActionTrail, you can use the value of this parameter to identify the user who assumes the RAM role. This provides user-level access auditing.

The name can contain letters, digits, periods (.), at signs (@), hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

The name must be 2 to 64 characters long
parameters.help_zh:
角色会话名称。

该参数为用户自定义参数。通常设置为调用该API的用户身份，例如：用户名。在操作审计日志中，即使是同一个RAM角色执行的操作，也可以根据不同的RoleSessionName来区分实际操作者，以实现用户级别的访问审计。

格式：包含英文字母、数字、半角句号（.）、at（@）、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。

长度：2~64个字符
parameters.name: role_session_name
